change_definition.current_behavior:
W3 P0 LEAP persisted seven stressor facets into pilot REQ/ARCH/IMPL with validated
pseudo-code. Existing unit tests in mcp-server/src/feature-orchestration/ cover baseline
execution recovery and idempotent create paths but do not map residuality stressor facets,
W3 APPEND_EVIDENCE/EVALUATE_DEPENDENCIES/HANDLE_LOCK_TTL blocks, or CONTROLLED_COMPOSITION_FAULT
bindings. Ten W2 `finding` rows and deferred S-T03 store-unavailable mapping remain
confirmation-only until executable tests exist.
change_definition.desired_behavior:
After W4 refine-plan, a documented test strategy maps P0 stressor facets and applicable
`finding` rows to unit RED targets and UI-free composition faults on queue/worker/store/idempotency
seams. Holdout validation stressors are scaffolded separately from design stressors.
build-plan W4 adds RED tests (and GREEN production code only in build-plan, not refine-plan)
following [PROC-TIED_DEV_CYCLE]: unit RED → unit GREEN → composition RED → composition GREEN.
S-T03 is clarified with split create-path (PUBLISH_FAILED) and execution-path (STORE_WRITE_FAILED
/ STORE_UNAVAILABLE) composition faults before any optional stack elevation.
non_goals: Production code GREEN in refine-plan W4
Claiming pilot DoD complete or holdout results
E2E UI tests for pilot seams (composition-first)
Promoting P1 deferred rows (S-T09, S-T10, S-T11, S-T16, S-O02, S-O06, S-O07) in W4 batch 1

sponsor_decisions.SD-W4-BATCH-SPLIT: Single build-plan batch vs split unit vs composition PRs (refine recommends phased sub-batches within one CITDP)

on mcp-server/src/feature-orchestration/ with module validation between unit and composition layers.
